name: spreadsheets
description: XLSX spreadsheet production skills, published as an official ZCode plugin. Includes a read-only workspace viewer for shared reading, search, references and captures.

description_i18n.en: Spreadsheet skills for XLSX: create, edit, analyze, chart, and convert workbooks. Read together in a read-only workspace panel with anchor references, search, highlights and captures.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 XLSX 的电子表格技能：创建、编辑、分析、图表与格式转换。 支持工作区只读共同阅读、锚点引用、搜索、高亮与截图。
